purpose: Allow Guide workers to propose and materialize bounded child/successor jobs through existing portfolio owners without creating shells, a scheduler, a queue, or new authority.
override_rule: Defaults may be changed only by an explicit packet/owner override carrying authority=CURRENT_OWNER_RECURSION_BUDGET_OVERRIDE and a durable source_ref. A child job cannot enlarge its own budget.

recursive_lineage_contract.depth: Root children are depth 1; every successor increments exactly by one.
recursive_lineage_contract.budget: Resolved immutable budget copied from the authorized root/owner context for audit only; it grants no authority.
recursive_lineage_contract.expires_at: Proposal validity horizon. Expiry suppresses new materialization but never invalidates an already won normal portfolio execution PIN.

priority_rule: Human-intent and already-productive CURRENT work preempt speculative/reserve descendants through existing portfolio priority/value_class ordering. Recursive descendants never receive an automatic priority boost.
authority_rule: Children do not inherit mutation authority, allowed paths, tool policy, execution ownership, promotion authority, or shell identity from a parent. Each child still requires a fresh normal portfolio PIN/claim compiled by CURRENT.
spawn_boundary: This mechanism creates durable work descriptions only. PLATFORM_SPAWN_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE remains a separate capacity boundary; capacity widgets may report missing shells but no child may create a ChatGPT shell.
dedupe_rule: Reuse canonicalDiscoveryIdentity/discoveryFingerprint from scripts/discovery-dedup-lib.mjs and the existing coordination/guide/successor-pins/<fingerprint>.json CREATE hard gate. Parent ids, worker ids, timestamps and wording never distinguish semantically equivalent residuals.
supersession_rule: A descendant is suppressed before materialization when an equivalent semantic fingerprint already exists, the target is superseded, the upstream artifact/version/digest changed, or the campaign/root is closed. Historical jobs remain append-only evidence.
fan_in_rule: A parent may close only when every blocking child is terminal PASS/consumed or explicitly superseded. A terminal FAIL opens only the bounded repair successor supported by evidence; advisory children may remain non-blocking. Fan-in emits the next grounded frontier or closure, never human routing by default.
truth_boundary: Policy and helper validation constrain Guide successor generation. They do not themselves CREATE a derived job, grant execution authority, alter CURRENT, spawn workers, or promote product state.
